description: Drainage District Benefited Lands is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Office of Public Works. Abstract: This data shows the land that was drained as part of the Drainage District. The original maps also identified other land owned by the same landowner so as to calculate the appropriate charge for maintenance. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Office of Public Works. Its tags are drainage district, drainage system, flooding, hydraulic engineering, river. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP, WMS. The portal shows 2022-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
